messages:
maria-support: Hey team, ACME reporting a P99 spike (~800ms) from ap-south to /v1/generate starting 11:12 UTC. Customer says latency and a couple of 502s. I have their trace id: trace-acme-9a7c.

leo-eng-sre: Thanks, any correlation with deploys or region failovers?

maria-support: No deploys. We saw a short flurry of auth token errors ~= 11:12:10 in their logs, then the spikes. Routing table looks normal from our side.

tim-runtime: Pinging from ap-south repro VM now, can you share a sample request id?

maria-support: sample request id: req-20260311-8d3f. Also attached the customer traceroute snippet (they pasted in channel):

maria-support: ```traceroute to api.redwood.example.com (34.210.12.66), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  1.0 ms  0.8 ms  0.9 ms
 2  52.95.20.1  6.1 ms  6.0 ms  6.2 ms
 3  13.224.45.9  120.9 ms 121.1 ms 121.0 ms
 4  * * *
 5  34.210.12.66  123.0 ms 122.8 ms 122.9 ms
 ```

akshat-plat: That hop at ~121ms looks like cross-region egress to US region. Can you share our server-side trace for trace-acme-9a7c?

leo-eng-sre: Pulling our trace now.

route-bot: [route-check] request=req-20260311-8d3f routed_via=eu-west-1 primary_region=ap-south resolved_region=us-east-1 fallback_reason=auth-service-unhealthy

leo-eng-sre: Interesting: route-check shows resolved_region=us-east-1 due to fallback_reason=auth-service-unhealthy. But auth-service in ap-south was OK per health API.

tim-runtime: I see a pattern: the jwt-introspect call in the auth sidecar timed out once, triggered runtime fallback to global auth endpoint in us-east for token validation, that added ~110-130ms RTT.

maria-support: Customer reported their SDK saw a 401 for a handful of requests around the same time. Could be the token-introspect timing out then forced cross-region validation.

leo-eng-sre: Can we confirm which healthcheck triggered the fallback? Oncall, can you check the auth-service healthchecks for ap-south from 11:10-11:15? @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: Looking... I see intermittent 504s from our internal auth probe at 11:11:58 and 11:12:04, both lasting ~2s. Root cause unclear, probe source IP 10.12.3.8 (ap-south-prober-1).

tim-runtime: Any network ACLs changed recently for prober?

akshat-plat: No infra changes in that window. But I see a config: REGION_FALLBACK_ORDER = [primary, global] and FALLBACK_TRIGGER_MS = 500. If introspect exceeded 500ms we bail to global.

leo-eng-sre: That threshold seems too low for occasional slow introspect under load. For ap-south p99 introspect was ~470ms, so a tiny blip crosses 500ms and triggers fallback.

maria-support: Customer said spikes lasted ~3 minutes then went away.

tim-runtime: Repro steps I ran from ap-south VM: 1) run curl to /v1/generate with malformed token to force introspect path 2) run load=50rps for 2m 3) watch route-check output. I reliably see 5-10% of requests routed to us-east when introspect latency > 500ms.

leo-eng-sre: Thanks. Root cause summary: transient auth-introspect latency in ap-south tripped our FALLBACK_TRIGGER_MS which directs runtime to validate tokens in us-east, adding ~120ms RTT and some 502/401 noise.

akshat-plat: Short-term mitigation: raise FALLBACK_TRIGGER_MS to 1200ms for ap-south region and add a cooldown to avoid rapid flip-flopping. Medium term: make fallback decision use consecutive-slow-sample count instead of single-sample threshold.

sre-oncall: I can push a hotfix to the runtime config (ap-south only) now, will monitor for 15m.

maria-support: Please also notify ACME that we're applying a mitigator and ask them to retry. I told them we were investigating.

tim-runtime: Patch applied to ap-south: FALLBACK_TRIGGER_MS=1200, FALLBACK_COOLDOWN=30s. route-bot now shows healthy routing.

route-bot: [route-update] region=ap-south FALLBACK_TRIGGER_MS set to 1200 by sre-oncall

leo-eng-sre: After the change I'm not seeing further cross-region hops in our test harness for the last 10 minutes.

maria-support: ACME confirms latency back to normal and no 502s. They asked for postmortem and to avoid surprise cross-region validations in future. :thumbsup:

akshat-plat: Action items: 1) tim-runtime: submit PR to change fallback logic to use 3 consecutive slow samples + cooldown (owner tim) 2) leo-eng-sre: add dashboard alert for cross-region-fallback-rate > 1% for >=5m (owner leo) 3) support: notify top 10 customers who have ap-region affinity about the change.

tim-runtime: I'll open the PR now, link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8421

leo-eng-sre: I'll create the dashboard.

maria-support: Thanks everyone. Closing thread after monitoring window ends.
